messages.content: What is the probability of getting a full house in poker?

function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

message.content:
**Full‑house probability (standard 52–card deck, 5 cards)**  

| Step | Calculation |
|------|-------------|
| Choose the rank that will appear **three times** | \(\binom{13}{1}=13\) ways |
| Pick which three of its four suits you get | \(\binom{4}{3}=4\) ways |
| → Ways to form the “triple” part: \(13\times4=52\) |

| Step | Calculation |
|------|-------------|
| Choose a **different** rank for the pair | \(\binom{12}{1}=12\) ways |
| Pick two of its four suits | \(\binom{4}{2}=6\) ways |
| → Ways to form the “pair” part: \(12\times6=72\) |

### Total favourable hands  
\(N_{\text{full}} = 52 \times 72 = 3\,744.\)

### All possible 5‑card hands  
\(N_{\text{total}}=\displaystyle\binom{52}{5}=2\,598\,960.\)

---

#### Probability

\[
P(\text{full house})
   = \frac{N_{\text{full}}}{N_{\text{total}}}
   = \frac{3\,744}{2\,598\,960}
   \approx 0.00144058
   \;\;(≈ 0.144 %). 
\]

In other words, roughly one hand in 694 has a full house.

---

### Quick Python check

```python
import math
prob = math.comb(13,1)*math.comb(4,3) * math.comb(12,1)*math.comb(4,2)
        / math.comb(52,5)
print(prob)          # prints 0.0014405760230714977
```

That matches the analytic result above.
